We present a comparative study of four such audits applicable to pre-trained, blackbox face generators: a Gaussian-mechanism reading of peridentity sensitivity (G AUSS M ECH ); a per-dimension kerneldensity log-ratio aggregated by basic composition (KDE- LR); an analytical population-level lower bound on pure- DP ε derived from the maximum mean discrepancy via the total variation distance (MMD-TV)
Index Terms —Differential privacy, privacy auditing, face recognition, maximum mean discrepancy, kernel density estimation, hypothesis testing, image-to-image generation.

data_generation_methods.evidence: Applied to Face- Fusion and InstantID across multiple identity encoders and reference datasets, the audits consistently reveal substantial identity distinguishability while reporting markedly different ε estimates that reflect each method’s distinct assumptions and finite-sample treatment.
